scenarios.label: Context: Assumed Current Static (12-min)
scenarios.description: Assumed unoptimized all-day 12-minute static headway with no peak timetable adjustment or bus rebalancing.

scenarios.label: Baseline: Best-Tuned Static Timetable
scenarios.description: Grid-searched time-of-day static timetable using optimal fixed headways for off-peak, morning peak, and afternoon peak.

scenarios.label: Policy B: Queue-Aware Dispatching
scenarios.description: Event-triggered dispatching whenever terminal queue reaches load threshold or oldest waiter approaches SLA bound.

scenarios.label: Policy C: Adaptive Headway Scheduling
scenarios.description: Continuously adjusts target departure interval H(t) via Newell square-root law on EWMA arrival intensity.

scenarios.label: Proposed: Combined Adaptive Optimizer
scenarios.description: Multi-criteria urgency scoring, traffic-compensated adaptive headways, surplus off-peak dispatch, and proactive directional rebalancing.

queuingVerification.des_justification: Off-peak M/M/c gives rho=0.170 (stable), matching simulation's low congestion (<3 min). At peak (13.2 pax/min on one terminal with lognormal 11.5m transit + traffic delay), unrebalanced half-fleet rho=1.478 >= 1.0 causes classical M/M/c queue blow-up and ignores K=50 bulk boarding batching and dynamic deadhead rebalancing, requiring DES.
